0022600020.text: The Miami Heat (1-4, 0-3 at home) host the Indiana Pacers (2-3) in Miami's sixth game of the season, with the Heat 13th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, 2 games back, while the Pacers are 10th in the East and third in the Central, also 2 games back, and enter on a two-game losing streak. Simone Fontecchio is day-to-day with an illness for Miami and is a game-time decision, while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Heat lost the season series 1-2, including a 135-118 loss in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
